bio: There’s a real buzz about this neighbourhood wine-bar-cum-bistro, which makes it so appealing as soon as you set foot through the door. The personable team keep things relaxed as they serve a seasonal tasting menu which comes with a subtle French slant and plenty of seafood – the restaurant’s name is French for whelk, so expect to find one somewhere on the menu. The simple, well-cooked dishes are also available from the à la carte as small plates....
